_meta.indication: POLIVY in combination with bendamustine and a rituximab product is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL), not otherwise specified, after at least two prior therapies (accelerated approval).

pivotal_trials.design: Open-label, multicenter trial; patients randomized 1:1 to POLIVY plus bendamustine and a rituximab product (BR) or BR alone for six 21-day cycles, stratified by duration of response to last therapy.
pivotal_trials.population: Adult patients with relapsed or refractory DLBCL who were not candidates for autologous HSCT; median age 69 years, median 2 prior therapies, 80% refractory to last therapy.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Complete response (CR) rate at the end of treatment and duration of response, as determined by an independent review committee.
pivotal_trials.result: CR rate at end of treatment 40% (95% CI 25, 57) with POLIVY+BR vs 18% (95% CI 7, 33) with BR alone; difference in CR rates 22% (95% CI 3, 41).

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥20%) included neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, anemia, peripheral neuropathy, fatigue, diarrhea, pyrexia, decreased appetite, and pneumonia. In the expanded safety population (n=173): neutropenia 44% (39% Grade ≥3), diarrhea 45% (8%), peripheral neuropathy 40% (2.3%), thrombocytopenia 31% (23%), anemia 28% (14%), pneumonia 13% (10%).
target_moa: CD79b-directed antibody-drug conjugate: the monoclonal antibody binds CD79b, a B-cell specific surface protein of the B-cell receptor; upon internalization the linker is cleaved and MMAE, an anti-mitotic agent, is released, binding microtubules to inhibit cell division and induce apoptosis of dividing B cells.

advisory_committee.vote: The application was not presented to the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee, as it did not raise significant efficacy or safety concerns.

description.text: Added first-line use in combination with rituximab, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, and prednisone (R-CHP) for previously untreated DLBCL NOS or HGBL with IPI score 2 or greater (regular approval)

citations.quote: Recommended Indication(s)/Population(s) (if applicable)	In combination with a rituximab product, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, and prednisone (R-CHP) for the treatment of adult patients who have previously untreated diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL), not otherwise specified (NOS) or high-grade B-cell lymphoma (HGBL) and who have an International Prognostic Index score of 2 or greater

Accelerated approval was granted for this indication based on complete response rate [see *Clinical Studies (14.1)*]. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in a confirmatory trial.

confirmatory_requirement.text: Verification of clinical benefit through either PMR 3630-1 (Study GO39942/POLARIX) or PMR 3630-2 (Study MO40598) would fulfill the accelerated approval requirement.
